svg.title: BenBen on its virtual twin
svg.desc: Illustration. A four-legged robot with a LiDAR dome on its head stands on a slab of LiDAR points with a raised step, a curb edge and a railing. A teal line shows the path it drove. A translucent scan fan reaches the step ahead. Four pins mark findings: amber reroute at the step, red report an issue at the curb, teal flag for service at a paper bag, grey needs a human further back.
svg.text: BenBen's twin: LiDAR points, path and findings. Illustration.
